title: Asus TUF Gaming VG249QE5A 24-Inch IPS 146Hz Review: Worth Buying for Gamers?
summary: The Asus TUF Gaming VG249QE5A is a 24-inch gaming monitor with an IPS panel, a 146Hz refresh rate and 125% sRGB color coverage. It is an attractive choice for gamers who want speed and good image quality in the mainstream segment.
description:
## Who is it for?

- FPS and eSports players.
- Anyone upgrading from a 60Hz or 75Hz monitor.
- Students and office workers who game after hours.
- Users who want an IPS monitor with good color for study, work and gaming.

## Why buy it?

- 146Hz gives a clear edge in fast-paced games.
- Great color thanks to the IPS panel and 125% sRGB coverage.
- Asus TUF Gaming is a highly reliable brand.
- A 3-year official warranty for long-term peace of mind.
- Competitive price among IPS gaming monitors.

sections.title: Design and build
sections.content: The Asus TUF Gaming VG249QE5A has a distinctly gaming look with a sturdy stand and thin bezels. Its 24-inch size fits most desks and gaming setups.

sections.title: Image quality
sections.content: With an IPS panel and 125% sRGB coverage, the monitor reproduces vivid colors with wide viewing angles. That is a big advantage not only for gaming but also for movies and basic content editing.

sections.title: Gaming performance
sections.content: A 146Hz refresh rate makes motion much smoother than on 60Hz or 75Hz monitors. In FPS, MOBA and Battle Royale games, you can clearly feel the difference in responsiveness and smoothness.

sections.title: Built-in speakers and everyday use
sections.content: The built-in speakers are a plus, so you do not need extra audio gear for basic use. For gamers and audiophiles, though, headphones or external speakers are still the better choice.

sections.title: Should you buy the Asus TUF Gaming VG249QE5A?
sections.content: If you are looking for a high-refresh IPS gaming monitor with good color from a reputable brand, the VG249QE5A is one of the most compelling options in the mainstream segment.

pros: IPS panel with good colors and wide viewing angles.
146Hz refresh rate for an extremely smooth gaming experience.
Built-in speakers are handy for basic use.
Part of the Asus TUF Gaming line, known for durability.
cons: Full HD is not ideal for users who want a sharper picture.
Built-in speakers are only good for basic listening.
buying_advice: Highly recommended for eSports players and everyday users who want a better display experience.

faq.question: Is the Asus TUF Gaming VG249QE5A good for FPS games?
faq.answer: Yes. The 146Hz refresh rate keeps motion smooth and helps your reactions in FPS games.

faq.question: Is this monitor suitable for office work?
faq.answer: Yes. The IPS panel and 24-inch size work well for study, work and everyday entertainment.

faq.question: Are the VG249QE5A's built-in speakers any good?
faq.answer: They are fine for basic use such as videos or online meetings, but they cannot replace a dedicated speaker system.
